health.purpose: Hostinger process health before and after recovery

version.purpose: Exact deployed commit and branch provenance

deployment_info.purpose: Independent exact deployed commit and branch provenance

response_chunk_durable_recovery_smoke.purpose: Prove the live RUNTIME_PERSISTENCE_DB binding can persist, evict, recover, checksum, reconstruct UTF-8, and extend TTL.

session_context.purpose: Session Context read-only topology/readback; this route does not prove INSERT authority

1048_transport_response_chunk_schema_rec.note: Ledger/schema presence alone is not live persistence proof; dedicated durable recovery smoke is required after apply recovery.

notes: Hostinger Auto Deploy is triggered only by a merge or push to Production; this contract never triggers a deployment.
A configured GitHub recovery step selects a route_key from this contract instead of supplying an arbitrary URL path.
The gpt_tool_call route is not a generic admin executor: unknown tools are denied, mutation semantics are phase-scoped, and 225/1048 are verification-only.

Direct SQL fallback is incident-scoped: only explicitly role-tagged or uniquely incident-allowlisted, checksum- and statement-count-pinned migrations in fallback_sql_policy can execute; unknown or baseline migrations are denied until separately reviewed.

The direct fallback consults the canonical governed_migration_ledger, verifies full schema/index/row postconditions, skips exact already-applied work, fails on ledger/schema divergence, and records same-cycle apply or record-only evidence.
Production bearer requests are allowed only to the canonical HTTPS origin in deployment-branch-policy.json production.hostname and branch Production.
404 or 405 means route_contract_missing; 401 or 403 means route_present_auth_not_ready; 5xx means route_present_runtime_dependency_failed.
A successful read-only Session Context response proves route/read topology only, not customer_sessions INSERT authority.
A migration ledger row for 1048 is not sufficient to prove the live runtime-persistence binding; durable response-chunk recovery must succeed against the live binding.
Functional success still requires the configured expected status and response contract.
